review.assetEvidence: NJ confirmed the application icon was commissioned through Codex and is safe to publish on 2026-09-06.
review.dependencyEvidence: Re-reviewed 2026-11-24 against the 2026-09-16 review: 6 new entries (Irodori-TTS v4 Large and Large-Quantized under the Gemma Terms, downloaded by the user at run time and never bundled; flatbuffers Apache-2.0; onnxruntime MIT; scipy 1.18.1 BSD-3-Clause with bundled-library notices; zstandard BSD-3-Clause), no removed entries and no changed licenses. Re-reviewed again 2026-11-24 after updating tauri-build 2.6.3 to 2.7.6 (fixes resource staging with Cargo 1.100's build folder layout): 23 added and 22 removed Cargo entries, all Apache-2.0, MIT, BSD-3-Clause, Zlib or MPL-2.0 (cssparser 0.37, cssparser-macros 0.7.1, selectors 0.38 unmodified, as before); no changed licenses. Re-reviewed again 2026-11-25 after the startup, uninstall and size work: no added entries; removed python-dotenv, python-multipart, uvloop and websockets (Python) and 21 Cargo entries; pnpm specifiers pinned to the already locked versions; tts_catalog.py changed only GPU memory requirements (no new models); no changed licenses.
review.limitations: Covers the SCENA source snapshot and collected notices, not dependency source trees, model weights, or arbitrary user-added models.

binaryReview.bundledComponents: Tauri application (cargo scope build-and-application), PyInstaller API sidecar with CPython (build-and-api, bundled-python-runtime), uv environment manager (bundled-environment-manager), compressed third-party notices shown in the app, NSIS installer stub, WebView2 download bootstrapper.
binaryReview.evidence: Bundle composition from src-tauri/tauri.windows.release.conf.json and tools/pyinstaller/scena-api.spec; tools/audit-pyinstaller-bundle.py enforces the sidecar contents during pnpm tauri:build:windows (Gitea Actions run 40 for v26.11.24 passed). MPL-2.0 files (cssparser, selectors, dtoa-short, option-ext, certifi, tqdm) are unmodified and their source is available from the listed registries; PyInstaller bootloader is GPL-2.0-or-later with the distribution exception; LGPL eslint-plugin-sonarjs and lightningcss are build tools only; CDLA-Permissive-2.0 webpki-roots text is included in the notices; NSIS stub is zlib licensed. Re-reviewed 2026-11-25: scena-api.spec now excludes more modules (numpy, watchfiles, hf_xet, interpreter tooling) and adds nothing; installer.nsi and installer-hooks.nsh only change uninstall defaults and remove stale runtime folders on install, with the same NSIS stub; Gitea Actions run 48 for v26.11.24 passed.
binaryReview.limitations: Unsigned installer. Covers the Windows x64 NSIS installer built from the same locked dependencies; models, CUDA runtimes and managed environments downloaded after installation keep their own terms. A change to the bundle-defining files or locks requires a new review.
